description: Registry of all oracle types recognized by the harness. Each oracle type describes a class of verifier evidence that can assess whether a success criterion is met.

oracles.description: Checks that expected files, directories, and structural elements exist at the correct paths. Does not verify content correctness.
Checks that the goal output behaves correctly through commands, test execution, or runtime checks.
Checks that the output has correct meaning, content, or structure through semantic analysis, diff, or validation.
Compares the output against a known-good reference, baseline, or alternative implementation.
Checks that certain failure modes, error patterns, or unsafe behaviors do NOT occur in the output.
Re-runs the certification decision from frozen evidence to verify the original result is reproducible.
Uses an external trusted system (human review, benchmark suite, third-party tool) to verify the outcome.
